4th Period.workingNow: Bringing your mechanics, dynamics, aesthetic and state map together into one design document.
4th Period.weeklyDeliverable: One design document in your portfolio repo bringing together your mechanics, dynamics, aesthetic and state map — plus your ROLLER game embedded and playable on your portfolio site — pushed by Sunday night.
4th Period.smartGoal: I can bring my whole design together into one document so that someone else could read it and build my mod without asking me anything.
4th Period.contentStandard: CA CS Standards 6-8.AP.19 — Document programs in order to make them easier to follow, test, and debug.
4th Period.eldStandard: ELD.PI.6-8.10 — Writing literary and informational texts to present, describe, and explain ideas and information.
agenda: Quick overview: today you assemble (3 min)
I do: what a complete design document looks like (12 min)
We do: check one section against the checklist (8 min)
You do: write your design document (22 min)
Exit Ticket: paste your document's link (3 min)
4th Period.connections: You have four separate pieces on four separate papers: mechanics, dynamics, aesthetic, state map. Today they become one document in your portfolio repo that reads start to finish. No code this week — the design IS the work. Tomorrow you put the game itself next to it.

6th Period.workingNow: Adding your fourth and fifth states, then checking that every state has a way in and a way out.
6th Period.weeklyDeliverable: A finished state machine diagram for one thing you choose — at least 5 states, every state with a labeled way in and a labeled way out — partner-tested and turned in by Sunday night.
6th Period.smartGoal: I can check my diagram for dead ends so that my thing can never get stuck in a state it cannot leave.
6th Period.contentStandard: CA CS Standards 6-8.AP.17 — Systematically test and refine programs using a range of test cases.
6th Period.eldStandard: ELD.PI.6-8.3 — Offering and supporting opinions and negotiating with others in communicative exchanges.
agenda: Quick overview: today you get to five (2 min)
I do: the vending machine, five states (12 min)
We do: find the dead end in my diagram (8 min)
You do: add states 4 and 5, hunt dead ends (22 min)
Exit Ticket: one state you added (3 min)
6th Period.connections: You have three states that go in a circle. Today you add two more and learn the one mistake that breaks every state machine: a state you can get into and never get out of. Tomorrow a partner tries to get your machine stuck.
